chron.src.annalist.court: The Chronicle of {court.name} lays it at the door of {blame.name}.
chron.src.annalist.dragon: The Chronicle of {court.name} lays it at your door.
chron.src.annalist.none: The Chronicle of {court.name} tells it and blames no one.
chron.src.teller.court: The tales of {court.name} say {blame.name} was behind it.
chron.src.teller.dragon: The tales of {court.name} say you were behind it.
chron.src.teller.none: The tales of {court.name} tell it and blame no one.
chron.src.inscription.none: The stones of {court.name} name no one.
chron.src.captive.court: Your captive from {court.name} says {blame.name} was behind it.
chron.src.captive.dragon: Your captive from {court.name} says you were behind it.
chron.src.captive.none: Your captive from {court.name} knows nothing of who was behind it.
chron.cf.not: Had you held back from {act}, {event} would not have come to pass.
chron.historian_died: {name}, who kept your chronicle, is dead. From {year} nothing of yours is written.
voice.emperor.found: {relic}, taken from {court.name}, speaks when you are alone: "Kings knelt under me. They can kneel again."
voice.emperor.idle: {relic} is quiet tonight, and pleased with your hoard.
voice.emperor.cannons: {relic} speaks: "They are building cannon. A crowned head is safer than a wild one."
voice.emperor.slayers: {relic} speaks: "Slayers stand ready. Give them a throne to kneel to and they will put down their spears."
voice.lichdom.found: {relic}, taken from {court.name}, speaks when you are alone: "The living will always build cannon. I can make you something cannon cannot reach."
voice.lichdom.idle: {relic} whispers of cold halls and long patience.
voice.lichdom.slayers: {relic} speaks: "The slayers are ready. Die once, the way I teach, and they will never kill you."
voice.lichdom.cannons: {relic} speaks: "They are building cannon. The living will always build cannon."
voice.lichdom.undead: {relic} speaks: "The dead walk in the valley. They would bow to a dead king."
voice.ascension.found: {relic}, taken from {court.name}, hums when you are alone: "They could love you. Let them."
voice.ascension.idle: {relic} hums a hymn nobody has written yet.
voice.ascension.cult: {relic} hums: "Someone in the valley prays to you. Answer them."
voice.ascension.magic: {relic} hums: "The air is thick with old craft again. Doors open in air like this."
voice.ascension.slayers: {relic} hums: "Slayers are ready. A god must be worth killing."
voice.sun_eater.found: {relic}, taken from {court.name}, burns warm when you are alone: "There is a bigger fire than yours."
voice.sun_eater.cannons: {relic} burns: "Their cannon are small fires. Eat a larger one."
voice.sun_eater.magic: {relic} burns: "The air is thick with old craft. The sky is close tonight."
voice.fact.slayers.1: Slayers are ready in the valley.
voice.fact.undead.1: An undead court stands in the valley.
voice.fact.undead.0: No undead court stands in the valley.
voice.fact.cult.1: A court holds you in awe and prays.
voice.fact.cult.0: No court prays to you yet.
voice.fact.magic.0: The world's magic is still thin.
